interpretation.conclusion: The available evidence localizes the issue to D placement and/or its thickness relative to the head banks; it does not establish whether the D registration or the local permissible gap is the root cause. Do not interpret these static point classifications as physical acceptance.
interpretation.finding: The frozen query localizes nearly all head containment to the deep D endpoint: iteration 003 has 75 ordinary D-inside columns, one additional I-inside endpoint, zero O-inside columns, plus one generated boundary-node hit (row 7237). Baseline already had 72 D-inside rows, one I row, and one generated row; iteration 003 adds four rows and removes one, net +3. The 088 iteration step itself moved points on these columns by at most about 0.0271 mm, while the 035-to-088 starting geometry already differs by millimetres.
interpretation.layer_scale: On the same D-hit columns, exact 035 source O-I median spacing is 2.451 mm and I-D is 10.256 mm; iteration-003 candidate medians are 2.252 mm and 10.277 mm. This makes the deep-layer spacing/gap a plausible contributor and argues against a broad outer-skin O penetration, but is not enough to distinguish a misregistered D layer from an insufficient local head gap.
interpretation.plane_limit: The closest-face plane projection is only a directional local diagnostic. It is not a finite-face intersection, full skull/head containment certificate, or anatomical clearance measure.

nearest_face_plane_projection_diagnostic.method: Transform same-column candidate O/I/D points with the exact body-23 world-to-body matrix and position/COM offset from 039; for each D hit use the saved nearest point and vector from that point toward D as the plane normal, then project O/I/D onto that infinite plane.

scope: Read-only analysis of frozen 088 iteration-003 static 185-bank query; no geometry edited, no query rerun, no physical/native qualification.
